title: A wallet joins a verifiable trust community, is vetted and holds its credentials
summary: A wallet of one implementation joins a trust community hosted by another, a vetter appointed under the community policy vets the member, and the wallet holds the membership and vetting credentials the community issues, which the host verifies again.
waitingOn: confirmation by Keyring or OpenVTC, with versions; then the same with a wallet of a third implementation

sides.version: Prague app build (keyring-bifold PR 56, TSP Rev 3 vendored)

results.note: Shown in Prague at Open Source Summit Europe, 7 to 9 October 2026: the first verifiable trust community for an open source project, with the Keyring app appointing and approving a vetter and the vetter vetting a new contributor. The date is that of the public report. Keyring's release harness also checks its vetting card with the upstream tool. Compiled from public sources, not entered by either side.
